name: Off the top of my head

meaning.zh:
“凭记忆” 或 “凭直觉”。

这个短语的起源可以追溯到人们用快速思考的方式提供答案而没有查找资料或进行深思熟虑的时候。通常用来表示一种即兴的反应或未经深思熟虑的回答。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from providing an answer quickly without consulting any references or deeply thinking about it. It is often used to indicate an impromptu response or an unrehearsed answer.

lines.en: I can't remember the exact date off the top of my head, but it was sometime in June.
lines.zh: 我记不清确切日期，但大概是在六月。

lines.en: Off the top of my head, I would say we need at least ten volunteers.
lines.zh: 凭记忆，我觉得我们至少需要十个志愿者。

lines.en: Do you know his phone number off the top of your head?
lines.zh: 你记得他的电话号码吗？
